b.answer:
Worked example: Glow Studio (fictional salon chain).

UAT · R02 "Every DM becomes an owned enquiry"
1 Send a test Instagram DM ............. contact + deal, owner set ≤ 5 min □
2 Owner logs a call from the app ....... activity on deal □
3 Send the same DM again ............... no new deal; note added □
Expected: ... Result: ... Tester: receptionist · Date:

Training plan: receptionist 30 min (morning inbox → assign → acknowledge); stylists 30 min (my bookings → log trial → move stage → deposit); branch managers 45 min (team dashboard, stuck deals); owner 20 min (monthly dashboard). Champions: one stylist per branch. Five 2-minute videos.
mistakes: Training on fake data nobody recognises.
b.pass: Five UAT scripts from real requirements with steps, expected results and pass/fail, and a role-based training plan built on each role's daily routine.
b.redo: Send it back if scripts can't be passed or failed objectively, or training is a feature tour.

s.answer:
Worked example: dashboards in a trial CRM with 200 sample deals.

  • Agent: my open deals by stage ("what do I do today?"), overdue tasks.
  • Manager: stuck > 14 days by owner ("who needs help?"), first-reply time by agent.
  • Owner: enquiries by source ("where to spend?"), weighted pipeline by close month ("cash plan"), lost reasons 90 days ("pricing?").
Adoption · week 2 (targets)
Active ≥ 4 days ............ 7/9  (≥ 8)
No next step ............... 18%  (< 10%) → make next-step required
Stage skips ................ 9%
First reply median ......... 26 min (< 30) ✓

Video: "Log a call and set the next step" (2 min 40 s).
mistakes: Charts without a question or decision.
s.pass: Three audience dashboards where every chart states its question and decision, an adoption report with at least four measured numbers against targets and actions, and one short training video.
s.redo: Send it back if charts have no stated decisions, adoption has no targets, or the video isn't role-focused.

g.answer:
Worked example of evidence (anonymised): real launch for a 10-person sales team.

UAT: 18 scripts · 18 pass · 6 defects fixed · 5 change requests logged
Week 1–4 active ≥ 4 days: 6 → 8 → 9 → 10 of 10
No next step: 31% → 12% → 9% → 6%
Handover: design, dictionary, register, integration map, admin routines,
          user list, credential locations, 6 videos
Client admins trained: 2 (ops manager, sales lead)
mistakes: Adoption reports that stop after launch week.
g.pass: UAT sign-off, four weekly adoption reports showing action taken, a complete handover pack (credential locations, not credentials) and two trained client admins, anonymised.
g.redo: Send it back if adoption wasn't tracked for four weeks, credentials appear in the pack, or routine admin still depends on you.
